title: Identity
description: Orders of {order} or more and bids of {bid} or more need a verified identity. Verify once and it counts everywhere with us.
loadFailed: We could not read your identity status. Try again in a moment.
verifiedUntil: Verified. Your document is valid until {day}.
expired: Your verified document has expired. Verify again with a current one.
checking: We are checking your ID — this usually takes a minute or two. You can leave this page; come back to see the result.
reviewing: We are reviewing your check. This can take a few days, and we need nothing from you.
declined: We could not verify your ID online. Try again with a clearer photo, or bring your ID to a visit and we will check it at the counter.
unavailable: Verification is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
requestedIdentity: We asked you to verify your identity.
requestedBusiness: We asked you to verify your business.

business.title: Business
business.description: Verify the business you buy for. Our verification partner checks its registration, the people who own or run it, and its documents.
business.personFirst: Verify your identity first. Then you can verify your business.
business.unverified: Your business is not verified yet.
business.peopleWaiting: Your business is approved. It is verified once each person named has verified their identity.
business.reviewDue: Your business is due for review. Verify it again to keep it verified.
business.reviewing: We are reviewing your business. This can take a few days, and we need nothing from you.
business.declined: We could not verify your business online. Check the details and documents, then try again.
business.ownersDescription: Each person named must sign in to their own account with us and verify their identity. Send each one their link.
business.inviteTitle: {business} named you as one of its people
business.inviteBody: Sign in to your own account and verify your identity to confirm it is you.
business.inviteInvalid: This link no longer works. Ask the business for a new one.
business.inviteLinked: You are now linked to {business}. Verify your identity below if you have not.
business.inviteNameMismatch: Your verified name does not match the person this link was sent to. Ask the business to check the name.
business.inviteAlreadyLinked: This person, or your account, is already linked to this business.
business.inviteVerifyFirst: Verify your identity first, then open this link again.
business.inviteReopen: This browser cannot keep your invite while you sign in. After signing in, open the invite link again.
business.loadFailed: We could not read your business status. Try again in a moment.
